questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

His disease is no doubt very serious but he will __pull over.__
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **pull through**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given phrasal verbs.
 
 
• **Pull over** is a piece of clothing, made of warm material, that is worn on the top part of the body and put on by pulling it over your head. (कपड़े का एक टुकड़ा, गर्म सामग्री से बना है, जो शरीर के शीर्ष भाग पर पहना जाता है और इसे अपने सिर पर खींच कर रखा जाता है)
 
• **Pull through** means to get through an illness or other dangerous or difficult situation. (किसी बीमारी या अन्य खतरनाक या कठिन स्थिति से निकलने के लिए)
 
• **Pull for** means to say or show that one hopes for someone or something will succeed, get well, etc. (यह कहना या दिखाना कि कोई किसी के लिए आशा करता है या कुछ सफल होगा, ठीक हो जाओ)
 
• **Pull against** means to exert force on so as to remove; extract. (हटाने के लिए बल लगाना; निकालना)
 
• **Pull at** means to pull something quickly and usually repeatedly. (कुछ जल्दी और आमतौर पर बार-बार खींचने के लिए)
 
 
 
• The implied meaning of the given sentence is: Although he has a very terrible illness, he will recover.
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate option is "**pull through**"

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Corrected sentence:** *His disease is no doubt very serious but he will pull through__.*

questions.question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The mother loving looked / at her baby / as the nurse / brought her in.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **The mother loving looked**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace "**loving**" with "**lovingly**" to correct the sentence.
 
• Adding **-ly** to the verb makes it an adverb.
 
• An **adverb **is a word or phrase that modifies or qualifies an adjective, verb, or other adverb or a word group, expressing a relation of place, time, circumstance, manner, cause, degree, etc.
 
• **Lovingly **means with love or great care.
 
 
• **Example -** *They smile lovingly at each other.*
 
 
 
• Love is a noun, which means an intense feeling of deep affection.
 
• Loving is an adjective that means feeling or showing love or great care. It is used in continuous tenses.
 
• Adjectives describe or modify nouns and limit or restrict the meaning of nouns and pronouns.
 
• **The implied meaning of the sentence is:** As the nurse brought the infant in, the mother gave her a kind gaze.
 
• So, an adverb should be used here.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1.**

**Corrected sentence:** *The mother lovingly looked at her baby as the nurse brought her in.*

questions.question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Where can I find the way to the library?

options.text: Where can they be found in the library?
They cannot be found in the way to library?
Where can the way to the library be found?
Who can found with the way to library?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Where can the way to the library be found?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active form and in the interrogative sentence and we need to change it into the passive form.
 
• The Interrogative sentence in the active voice has the following form: Wh word+ modal verb + doer + main verb + object +?__
 
• The Interrogative sentence in the passive voice has the following form: __Wh word + modal verb+ object + be verb + V3 + by + doer +? __
 
• Example - 
 
 
• Active voice - *What kind of change would you suggest?*
 
• Passive voice - *What kind of change would be suggested by you?*
 
 
 
• Rules of Conversion from Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, the verb, and the object.
 
• Change the object into the subject.
 
• Change the verb into the past participle form of the verb.
 
• Change the subject into an object.
 
 

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct Passive Voice: *Where can the way to the library be found?*
